# A platform override's parameter sharing a name with the program's state,
# run on every target a test can execute on:
# testdata/override_param_shadow.txtar is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var on = false
    var v = "x"
    var seen = ""
    vbox {
        checkbox #box(@change { on = !on })
        input #field(@input { v = v + "!" })
        toggle #sw(@change(c) { seen = "{c} {on}" })
    }
}

func testShadow(t Test, c main) {
    c.box.change(true)
    t.assert(c.on == true)
    c.field.input("q")
    t.assert(c.v == "x!")
    c.sw.change(true)
    t.assert(c.seen == "true true")
}

window {
    main
}
